summary: Prediction, not yet built, and the retrospective part: a Leaderboard Service, real Alpaca/Massive stock data, and Stripe's undecided role.

nodes.label: Reader
nodes.purpose: A blog reader exploring Bullpen's architecture timeline on the landing site.

nodes.label: Player
nodes.purpose: A registered player competing in a league and checking the leaderboard.

nodes.label: Bullpen Landing
nodes.purpose: The public landing site with the architecture timeline explorer, now covering all six parts.

nodes.label: Bullpen Trading App
nodes.purpose: The trading app where players trade, view leagues, and check the leaderboard.

nodes.label: Prices Service
nodes.purpose: Owns live price snapshots, now sourced from Alpaca and Massive instead of Part 1's placeholder provider.

nodes.label: Prices Database
nodes.purpose: Neon Postgres database owned solely by the Prices Service.

nodes.label: Market History Service
nodes.purpose: Serves historical price/candle queries independently of live snapshots, with its own write path and own database.

nodes.label: Market History Database
nodes.purpose: Neon Postgres database owned solely by the Market History Service.

nodes.label: Orders Service
nodes.purpose: Accepts paper trade order requests and publishes them onto the market-open queue.

nodes.label: Market Open Queue
nodes.purpose: Buffers the burst of order requests at market open so the Order Saga consumes them at a sustainable rate.

nodes.label: Order Saga
nodes.purpose: Durable workflow orchestrating each queued order: price lookup, balance check, fill, and ledger update.

nodes.label: Ledger Service
nodes.purpose: Owns player balances and positions; the source of truth the Leaderboard Service ranks against.

nodes.label: Leaderboard Service
nodes.purpose: Ranks players within leagues from ledger balances and positions; leagues are groups of players competing over the same period.

nodes.label: Alpaca
nodes.purpose: US stocks broker/market-data provider; resolves Part 1's open "Market Data Provider" placeholder for equities.

nodes.label: Massive
nodes.purpose: US market-data provider (formerly Polygon.io) offering real-time and historical equities data via REST and WebSocket; used alongside Alpaca.

nodes.label: Stripe
nodes.purpose: Payments provider whose role in Bullpen is undecided as of this prediction. Bullpen is a non-commercial prototype with no billing today (ADR-0001).

request.name: An order, ranked on the leaderboard

steps.caption: Submit
steps.detail: Player submits a paper trade order from the ticket.

steps.caption: Queue it
steps.detail: Buffered for a sustainable processing rate.

steps.caption: Consume
steps.detail: The Order Saga picks up queued orders.

steps.caption: Price
steps.detail: Priced from Alpaca (stocks) or the crypto provider.

steps.caption: Reserve, fill and settle
steps.detail: Balances and positions update through the Ledger Service.

steps.caption: Rank
steps.detail: The Leaderboard Service re-ranks the league from the updated ledger.
